attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 36, `ygeA` to `fucI`, are carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 23% of calls. The model names 7 to 100% of them, fewest at column 7, `ygdR`, 7%.

**A single variable column follows**, column 37, `fucP`, shell, carried by 85%. Through columns 60 to 62 a branch of 3 shell families runs in 11 to 15%, a parallel path some chromosomes carry instead.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.19 against 0.45 bits. It hesitates most at column 60, `ygcG`, a fork column, 1.29 bits.

**The last column is `casB`**, in 20% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.28 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.83 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 95%.

label: ygeA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ygeA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ygeA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 890 to 969 from dnaA. Read in 532 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ygeA once); 42,560 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,943 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 9,263 calls, named 86%, 0.74 bits; cloud 354 calls, named 32%, 2.93 bits. Outside an RGP 33,837 calls, named 95%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 8,723 calls, named 85%, 0.83 bits. Columns: 53 spine, 7 fork, 20 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.83 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 95%); 8,723 of the 42,560 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 60 (ygcG, a fork column) 1.29 bits, RGP 65%; column 78 ("IS4-like element IS421 family transposa…", a fork column) 1.00 bits, RGP 55%; column 77 (small, a fork column) 0.87 bits, RGP 49%. The 13 columns (columns 60-70 and 78-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.60 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 94%, 0.22 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 53 spine columns: named 94%, 0.19 bits on average; the 27 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.45 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 60, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 54-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 3-81%; the least: columns 0-36 (spine), RGP 0-23%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-36 (37 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0-23%. Genes: ygeA "amino acid racemase", lysR, lysA "diaminopimelate decarboxylase", galR, aas, lplT, tas, ygdR "lipoprotein YgdR", ygdQ "TerC family protein", mutH, ygdT "protein YgdT", rppH, ptsP, lgt, thyA, ppdA "prepilin peptidase-dependent protein", ppdB, ygdB "DUF2509 family protein", ppdC, recC, ptrA, recB "exodeoxyribonuclease V subunit beta", recD, argA, amiC, mltA, tcdA, csdE "cysteine desulfurase sulfur accepto…", csdA, ygdI "YgdI/YgdR family lipoprotein", gcvA, ygdD "DUF423 domain-containing protein", rlmM, fucR "L-fucose operon activator", fucU, fucK, fucI. named 7-100% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 7 (ygdR), named 7%; most hesitant at column 25 (mltA), 0.73 bits.
[S2] 2. column 37 variable: share 85%, all S, RGP 19%. named 94%; 0.59 bits.
[S2.c37]    37: fucP S 85%
[S3] 3. columns 38-53 (16 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 3-19%. Genes: fucA, fucO, xni, sdaB, sdaC "HAAAP family serine/threonine perme…", ppnN, queF, syd, yqcC "YqcC family protein", truC, yqcA "flavodoxin", gudP "galactarate/glucarate/glycerate tra…", gudX, gudD, barA, rlmD. named 45-99% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 50 (gudX), named 45%; most hesitant at column 41 (sdaB), 0.38 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 54-79 (26 columns) fork and variable columns: share 20-89%, 14 S, 12 P, RGP 3-81%. named 75-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 77, named 75%; most hesitant at column 60, 1.29 bits.
[S4.b60]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 60-62, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-15%, all S; the branch's families: "TPM domain-containing protein", "TPM domain-containing protein", "LemA family protein"
[S4.c54-59]    columns 54-59 variable, share 78-89%, 4 P, 2 S: relA 89%, mazE 78%, mazF 78%, mazG "nucleoside triphosphate pyrophospho…" 86%, pyrG 86%, eno 85%
[S4.c60]    60 fork: ygcG S 65% "TPM domain-containing protein"
[S4.c61]    61 fork: yqcG S 48% "cell envelope stress response prote…"
[S4.c62]    62 fork: queE P 85%
[S4.c63]    63 fork: ygcE S 77% "FGGY-family carbohydrate kinase"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 19%
[S4.c64-76]    columns 64-76 variable, share 73-80%, 7 S, 6 P: yqcE "MFS transporter" 77%, ygcW "SDR family oxidoreductase" 76%, ygcU "FAD-binding oxidoreductase" 77%, ygcS "MFS transporter" 78%, ygcR "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 79%, ygcQ "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 76%, ygcP "glycerol-3-phosphate responsive ant…" 78%, ygcO "ferredoxin family protein" 78%, ygcN "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase" 75%, queD 80%, cysJ 79%, cysI "assimilatory sulfite reductase (NAD…" 77%, cysH 73%
[S4.c77]    77 fork: small P 41%; also cas3 S 19%
[S4.c78]    78 fork: "IS4-like element IS421 family transposa…" S 22%; also cas3 S 20%, casA S 14%
[S4.c79]    79 fork: casB S 20%; also casA S 17%, iap P 16%, cas7e S 11%
